com.irurueta.authserver.serviceclient - package com.irurueta.authserver.serviceclient

com.irurueta.authserver.serviceclient.device - package com.irurueta.authserver.serviceclient.device
Command-line client of the OAuth 2.0 device authorization grant (RFC 8628): requests a device code, shows the user code and verification URI, and polls the token endpoint until the user approves the request.
